skills.name: clipper
skills.description: Short-form video strategist that turns a long video into three publishable clips. Fetches a YouTube transcript (or reads a timestamped .txt/.srt/.vtt), scores every 15-60 second window for hook, emotion, tactical, and surprise density, then returns the top 3 non-overlapping segments with exact start/end timestamps, a 1-100 viral score with a one-sentence justification, a bold visual hook overlay for the first 3 seconds, and a platform caption with 3-5 hashtags. Enforces three hard constraints: no clip under 15s or over 60s, no fabricated transcript dialogue, and no timestamp that does not land on a real cue boundary. Refuses with one fixed sentence when the input is missing, empty, corrupted, or has no usable dialogue. scripts/clip.py also renders the selected segments to 9:16 .mp4 with ffmpeg. Use when clipping long videos, finding viral moments, making Shorts/Reels/TikTok cuts, or repurposing a webinar, podcast, or interview. Not for full-length editing, color grading, or subtitle rendering.

sub_skills.name: window-scoring

sub_skills.name: clip-selection

sub_skills.name: accuracy-gate
sub_skills.description: Verify every timestamp sits on a real cue boundary, every duration falls inside 15-60 seconds, and every quoted phrase is a verbatim excerpt from the source transcript.
